arms.r17bal: rank 16 on the action expert, 8 negatives per batch of 32 (PRIMARY)
arms.r17fold: rank 2 on the last two layers (258 KB), 8 per batch
arms.r17pool: rank 16, negatives at their natural frequency

metrics.data: m5_practice + m6_round1 recordings (the success-only round-2 learner r16L2's data); positives identical to r16L2's
metrics.experiment: Exp. 1 of reports/RL from practice for composition.md: negative-aware retraining on the recordings of rounds 0-1

hypotheses.N1: r17bal > lora_r16L2 (success-only, same data) on states 30-49 of the 21 tasks: paired sign test p < 0.05
hypotheses.N2: r17fold > lora_r16eq2 (success-only 258 KB, same data): paired sign test p < 0.05

metrics.loss: DiffusionNFT, beta = 1 (positives: plain flow matching, as the control; negatives: reflected velocity 2 v_ref - v_theta toward the executed chunk), reference = the frozen prior (adapter off); 1000 steps, lr 1e-4, batch 32
metrics.negatives: failed rollouts: the executed chunks at the last W = 2 policy queries up to the stall (first query at which the composition's demo-alignment pointer, recomputed from recorded states, reaches its final maximum); rest unlabelled
